extDescription.message: Rotate, reorder, delete, merge and split PDF pages right in Chrome. For DealerInk dealerships.

badgeTitle.message: PDF found: click to edit it

notifyToggle.message: Offer to edit PDFs I download

signInBody.message: Use your DealerInk email and password.

codeBody.message: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enrollBody.message: The editor needs two-factor verification. Open DealerInk, set it up under Settings, Security, then click Check again.

deniedDisabled.message: This account was switched off. Contact DealerInk support.

deniedNoDealership.message: This account does not belong to a dealership in DealerInk.

deniedNoPlan.message: Your dealership's DealerInk plan is not active. Ask the dealership owner to renew it.

deniedUnavailable.message: The plan check is not available yet. Try again in a few minutes.

offlineBody.message: The editor checks your account when it opens. Connect to the internet and click Check again.

errorCode.message: That code is not valid. Enter the current code.

noPdfHere.message: This tab is not showing a PDF. Open the editor and choose a file, or open a PDF in Chrome first.

emptyBody.message: Files stay on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.

countPages.message: $1 pages. Click to select, Ctrl or Shift for more, drag to reorder, double-click to enlarge.

errorFileAccess.message: Chrome does not let the editor read files on this computer. Drag the file into this window, or turn on "Allow access to file URLs" for this extension in chrome://extensions.

errorUnreachable.message: Could not get this PDF from the site. Download it and drag it into this window.

errorNotPdf.message: This file is not a PDF. If the site asked you to sign in again, sign in, download the PDF and drag it here.

errorDownloadMissing.message: The downloaded file was moved or deleted. Drag it into this window.

errorEncrypted.message: This PDF is protected and cannot be edited.

errorDamaged.message: This PDF could not be read. It may be damaged.
